_README: FILTRATION TRIALS - the most valuable data in this project.
A trial measures the thing the screening is actually trying to predict:
how much MORE water goes through a filter when the feed has been through a
hydrocyclone first. Everything else in this repository is an attempt to
estimate that number from geology and assumed particle sizes. A trial
measures it directly, and always beats the estimate.
The shape the user described is exactly right:
'with a 5 um filter of 47 mm diameter of this material, before
hydrocyclone processing we got through 50 mL, then after hydrocyclone
processing the overflow got 75 mL'
-> volumeRatio 1.5
WHAT TO RECORD, AND WHY EACH FIELD MATTERS
volumeBeforeMl / volumeAfterMl
The measurement. 'After' is the hydrocyclone OVERFLOW - the stream a
plant would actually send to the membrane - not the underflow.
terminalCondition   THE FIELD MOST OFTEN FORGOTTEN.
'How did you decide to stop?' A volume filtered to complete blockage
is not comparable with one filtered for five minutes, or to a fixed
vacuum. Without this the two numbers cannot be compared at all, and
the trial is unusable. Be specific.
filter.poreSizeUm / diameterMm
Area scales with diameter squared, so a 47 mm disc passes about four
times what a 25 mm disc does. Volumes are meaningless without it.
feed.material / feed.preparation
A hydrocyclone's performance depends on what it is fed. Crushed
aquarium soil is not river silt. Recording preparation is what makes
a bench result transferable - or honestly marks it as not.
feed.concentrationMgL
Optional but valuable: volume scales as 1/sqrt(concentration), so two
trials at different loadings are not directly comparable without it.
replicates
One pair of numbers is an anecdote. Three is a result. Record how many
and the spread if you have it.

feed.preparation: Supplied as pellets, crushed with a pestle and mortar before use.
feed.note: A bench feed, not a natural water. Useful for characterising the hydrocyclone itself; NOT evidence about any particular site until a natural feed is run.

notes: Placeholder created from the description given. Fill in the numbers and set status to 'recorded'.
volumeRatio is deliberately NOT stored - it is computed from the two volumes, so it can never drift out of step with them.
